description: The AS2 agreement acknowledgement connection settings.

ignoreCertificateNameMismatch.description: Indicates whether to ignore mismatch in certificate name.

keepHttpConnectionAlive.description: Indicates whether to keep the connection alive.

supportHttpStatusCodeContinue.description: Indicates whether to support HTTP status code 'CONTINUE'.

unfoldHttpHeaders.description: Indicates whether to unfold the HTTP headers.
